artists.name: Hana Ito
artists.quote: A cup should feel like it was waiting for your hand.
bio: Hana runs Kiln & Kin from a converted machiya in northern Kyoto with one apprentice and a shared anagama kiln that fires four times a year.
Commissions are scheduled around those firings, so timelines are honest and fixed. She will send glaze tiles to choose from before your pieces are thrown.

reviews.quote: Our restaurant’s plates are the first thing guests photograph.
reviews.author: Kai L., Osaka

reviews.quote: Packed so carefully nothing chipped across an ocean.
reviews.author: Emma T., Seattle

reviews.quote: Hana sent glaze tests before firing. Lovely process.
reviews.author: Mira S., Berlin

artists.name: Ines Folau
artists.quote: Every thread is a decision. I like to make them slowly.
bio: Ines learned to weave from her grandmother in Tonga and now works on a 2.4-metre floor loom in a studio overlooking the Waitematā.
She dyes most of her wool by hand, and every large commission begins with a palette of yarn samples posted to you.

reviews.quote: Ines measured our stairwell twice and it fits like it grew there.
reviews.author: Sam & Lou, Wellington

reviews.quote: The colours shift with the afternoon light.
reviews.author: Rangi P., Auckland

reviews.quote: A calm, thoughtful collaborator.
reviews.author: Claire D., Sydney

artists.name: Theo Laskaris
artists.quote: I wait for the second after people, and horses, stop posing.
bio: Theo photographs families and the animals they love, from newborns in a poppy field to a horse in its own paddock. He shoots mostly on medium-format film and prints in a darkroom he built in an old barn outside Bozeman.
Commissions include an unhurried outdoor session, a contact sheet you choose from, and hand-made prints you keep.

reviews.quote: Our family photos finally look like us.
reviews.author: Kate R., Missoula

reviews.quote: Fast, funny, and the prints are beautiful.
reviews.author: Hannah W., Denver

reviews.quote: He got our old mare to look at the camera. A miracle.
reviews.author: Dimitra & Leo

artists.name: June Abernethy
artists.quote: Watercolour only works if you let the water have its say.
bio: June paints in watercolour and ink at a desk by the window in her Partick flat, working from walks along the Clyde and sittings in the studio.
Every commission starts with a sheet of quick colour studies. You pick a favourite, and she builds the finished painting from it.

reviews.quote: Our painting of the loch is the best gift I have ever given.
reviews.author: Fiona C., Edinburgh

reviews.quote: Quick colour studies, quicker replies.
reviews.author: Tom & Ade, Leeds

reviews.quote: She painted our cat into the window without being asked.
reviews.author: Isla M., Glasgow

artists.name: Lena Vossberg
artists.quote: I want the weight of a thing to be part of what it says.
bio: Lena works from a former tram depot in Wedding, with a small foundry partner outside the city.
Commissions begin with a plaster maquette you can hold, and every piece ships with its plinth and installation drawings.

reviews.quote: The maquette stage made the decision easy.
reviews.author: Garten Haus, Munich

reviews.quote: Installed perfectly in our courtyard.
reviews.author: Anke & Paul, Hamburg

reviews.quote: A serious artist with a light touch.
reviews.author: R. Okafor, London

artists.name: Sol Amari
artists.quote: Tell me about a place you love. I’ll paint it the way it felt to be there.
bio: Sol paints in oil on canvas and board in a rooftop studio in the medina, usually in the early morning light.
Send photographs of a place or person that matters to you and she will paint it, starting with a small colour study.

reviews.quote: Painted the riad where we married. Perfect.
reviews.author: Yasmin & Joe

reviews.quote: Framed and shipped beautifully.
reviews.author: Claudia F., Milan

reviews.quote: Gentle, warm, very professional.
reviews.author: Omar B., Rabat

artists.name: Clémence Aubry
artists.quote: Flowers last a week. I try to keep the light on them a little longer.
bio: Clémence paints flowers and gardens from life in a glasshouse studio on the edge of Ghent.
Bring or send the flowers, or invite her to a garden that matters to you. Each commission begins with a small oil sketch.

reviews.quote: She painted the roses from our wedding before they faded.
reviews.author: Anouk & Pieter, Antwerp

reviews.quote: The garden looks exactly as my mother kept it.
reviews.author: Hélène D., Lille

artists.name: Anders Bell
artists.quote: I paint the fish I meet when I close my eyes.
bio: Anders paints soft, glowing fish that drift through night skies, caves and coral, in a top-floor studio overlooking the harbour in Copenhagen.
Tell him about a dream, a person or a place, and he will turn it into a scene of its own. Every commission starts with a small oil sketch.
